rules: Only the 18 existing breakthrough/reference and breakthrough/wider cases are exported. Each source case is solved unchanged and its complete compact record, including the original fuel addendum, must equal the admitted base product before valuation.

All registered physical assets are included: settlement enclosures and utilities, housing materials and roads, industry, freighters, power, computers, commercial factories, research/service facilities and hotels. Functional-sector labels do not assign legal ownership.

Gross stock is surviving active/structural mass times its inherited component replacement quote. Local structure quotes remain account values; they are not added to cash purchases or internal profits. Freight, common programme cost, payroll, fuel, resource provisions and the finance capital allowance are not automatically capitalized.

Net stock is an undiscounted remaining-service proxy: for original cohort quantity q, price p and survival S(age), q*p*sum_{j>=age}S(j)/sum_{j>=0}S(j). It equals new replacement value on commissioning and declines under the existing uncalibrated survival law. It is not a sale, collateral or market value.

Fresh commissioning adds both growth and replacement components once. Expected retirements remove surviving gross stock; remaining-service consumption changes net stock. Replacement expenditure is not added again to asset stock. Service lives and the Weibull shape remain unchanged.

Normal construction WIP follows the source half-order in each of the two years before commissioning. Seed commissions preserve the exact source cohorts in years 0–7. For seed WIP only, the same two-year convention is used with negative manufacture dates moved to year zero. Year-zero equipment is immediately commissioned. This added valuation convention does not establish a deployable bootstrap schedule or change finance's uniform seed-spending dates.

End-year WIP includes already fabricated parts of cohorts commissioning after year 220. It remains separate from commissioned assets. Asset stock identities reconcile at replacement-quote values, not to the differently scoped cash procurement account.

Core physical service/hotel assets are included once. The separate commercial package residual, intellectual property, goodwill, legal resource rights and ownership shares require a consumer-side specification and have no inferred value here.

The tracked product retains every annual total and functional-sector balance, and full component stocks at years 8/32/100/200/220. Complete cohorts and annual component states can be regenerated into ignored run files; their canonical identity is retained. Net-value retirement uses retired mass at its prior surviving-unit book value, with the residual net decrease attributed to aging. These two terms sum to the total remaining-service consumption proxy.
unvalued_assets: Unitemized service/culture/premium/logistics package residual above identified physical facilities; its quoted stock is available in the humanities orderbook, not identified component cohorts.

Internally developed intellectual property, software, brands, sports rights, research knowledge and goodwill: no inventory, capitalization split, useful lives, market or collateral values are established.
Public/community ownership claims, equity ownership, land and mineral rights, ecosystem/cultural heritage and human capital: no legal allocation or exchange value is established.
Priced seed launch fuel and cash working/reserve balances are excluded from fixed equipment. Transit inventories, remaining first-source sequence and passenger access are not qualified.
